name: v243_legal_credit_ma_minus_earnings
hypothesis: Legal, credit-rating, and M&A sentiment should be most useful when it is not just ordinary earnings-news optimism. A small profitability/reversal sleeve keeps the signal tradable while the negative earnings-sentiment term residualizes against existing earnings-news actives.
expression: 0.100 * group_rank(ts_rank(operating_income / equity, 126), industry) + 0.060 * rank(-(close / open - 1)) - 0.160 * group_rank(ts_rank(mean_earnings_evaluation_sentiment, 60), industry) + 0.060 * group_rank(ts_rank(mean_merger_acquisition_sentiment, 90), industry) + 0.050 * group_rank(ts_rank(rp_nip_credit_ratings, 90), industry) + 0.050 * group_rank(ts_rank(rp_nip_legal, 90), industry) + 0.040 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * (systematic_risk_last_60_days - systematic_risk_last_360_days), 60), industry)
notes: Derived from post-116 short-active PnL residual: +LLpGdlrm - RRpmOAWj + e7OQoveE. Reject if it maps to e7OQoveE, RRpmOAWj, Vkp0P130, or product/legal news actives.

name: v243_legal_credit_ma_minus_customer_attention
hypothesis: Legal/credit/M&A news can represent balance-sheet or governance repricing distinct from customer-network attention. Subtracting customer-authority attention tests whether the news route has independent residual value.
expression: 0.090 * group_rank(ts_rank(operating_income / equity, 126), industry) + 0.030 * rank(-(close / open - 1)) - 0.180 * group_rank(ts_rank(pv13_ustomergraphrank_auth_rank, 60), industry) + 0.080 * group_rank(ts_rank(mean_merger_acquisition_sentiment, 90), industry) + 0.067 * group_rank(ts_rank(rp_nip_credit_ratings, 90), industry) + 0.067 * group_rank(ts_rank(rp_nip_legal, 90), industry) + 0.053 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * (systematic_risk_last_60_days - systematic_risk_last_360_days), 60), industry)
notes: Derived from +LLpGdlrm - RRpmO2xb + e7OQoveE. It intentionally avoids CFO, cost/gross, EBIT, EPS, sales delivery, and option terms.

name: v243_corporate_action_event_residual
hypothesis: Corporate-action and general event sentiment may capture capital-allocation or governance news that is not the same as earnings sentiment; the negative earnings-news sleeve is used only as a residualizer.
expression: trade_when(ts_rank(volume / adv20, 20) < 0.70, 0.280 * group_rank(ts_rank(mean_corporate_action_sentiment, 90), industry) + 0.180 * group_rank(ts_rank(mean_event_sentiment_score, 90), industry) + 0.160 * group_rank(ts_rank(mean_event_novelty_score, 90), industry) - 0.240 * group_rank(ts_rank(mean_earnings_evaluation_sentiment, 60), industry) + 0.080 * rank(-1 * ts_rank(returns * (volume / adv20), 10)) + 0.060 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * (systematic_risk_last_60_days - systematic_risk_last_360_days), 60), industry), -1)
notes: Cold-ish RavenPack matrix route using high coverage / low alphaCount fields, but not product/business/news12 path-speed or ordinary earnings-only sentiment.

name: v243_pv13_authority_anti_competitor_news
hypothesis: Supplier/customer authority can be informative when it is not simply competitor-return or earnings-news absorption. This tests authority breadth as a residual signal under light profitability support.
expression: 0.300 * group_rank(ts_rank(pv13_com_rk_au, 60), industry) + 0.130 * group_rank(ts_rank(operating_income / assets, 126), subindustry) - 0.190 * group_rank(ts_rank(pv13_ompetitorgraphrank_hub_rank, 60), industry) - 0.160 * group_rank(ts_rank(rp_nip_earnings, 90), industry) + 0.080 * rank(-(close / open - 1)) + 0.060 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * rel_num_comp, 126), industry)
notes: A compact relationship residual, not a customer/PPE/profit or social/profit/book sibling. Reject on high corr to O0pNbJ17, RRpmO2xb, d5xj5W5v, or v239 social/profit residual.
